description: Source code for AndroidFindStyleApplicationsProcessor class, which extends BaseRefactoringProcessor to find and apply style applications in Android layout files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidFindStyleApplicationsProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes Android style applications for refactoring within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

methods.name: createUsageViewDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a descriptor for the usage view, describing the style to use.

methods.name: findUsages
methods.description: Finds all usages of the style in layout files.

methods.name: preprocessUsages
methods.description: Preprocesses usages before performing refactoring, showing info if no usages are found.

methods.name: performRefactoring
methods.description: Performs the refactoring by applying style to layout elements.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name for the refactoring operation.

methods.name: collectFilesToProcess
methods.description: Collects layout files to process for style application.

methods.name: findAllStyleApplications
methods.description: Finds all style applications in given layout files.

methods.name: collectPossibleStyleApplications
methods.description: Collects possible style application points within a layout file.

methods.name: isPossibleApplicationOfStyle
methods.description: Checks if a given XML tag is a possible application of the style.

methods.name: setSearchOnlyInCurrentModule
methods.description: Sets whether to search only within the current module.

methods.name: setFileToScan
methods.description: Sets a specific file to scan.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this processor.

methods.name: getStyleName
methods.description: Returns the style name being processed.

methods.name: configureScope
methods.description: Configures the scope of the search (project, module, or file).
